note: Editorial order for Explore by theme / sector. Key = '<kind>:<slug>' (theme bundle code or sector slug); value = use case ids, most recognisable example first. Only ids that are published AND match the choice are used, in this order; the remaining slots follow the default order (in production first, then newest). An id that is missing from the catalog is skipped, so a stale entry never breaks a page. Nothing is shown that the record does not say: cards, images and status badges come from the record.
